subject: attn
title: (R)ATTN.------AF.DY.
description: Diagram in CMBA-27. (R)ATTN — the reality of attraction — is crossed with AFL-DY (affinity dynamics). The diagram poses what real attraction (the actual draw a music exerts on its audience and its players) requires structurally to be more than fashion. AFL-DY → ATTN, and CULT-INFO-DY (culture information dynamics) → ATTN. CULT-INFO-DY also feeds AFL (affinity alignment). AFL-DY also branches to INDIV-TD (individual tendencies) → AFTD (affinity tendencies) → C-INFO (composite information). A separate sub-chain: SOC-RT-P (social reality particulars) has a *dashed* edge to (R)AFI (the reality of affinity insight), and AFI → DYM-F (dynamic functionalism). Structural argument: real attraction is downstream of affinity dynamics *and* culture information dynamics together — meaning attraction requires both the affinity-grounded vibrational pull *and* the cultural-information-dynamics that route attention. The individual-tendencies → affinity-tendencies → composite-information chain runs as a parallel constituting layer of the affinity-dynamics side. The dashed edge from social-reality-particulars to the reality of affinity insight registers that the social-reality-particulars route to real affinity insight is conditional — meaning Braxton's structural worry is that social reality alone doesn't reliably produce real affinity insight. Real affinity insight, once established, produces dynamic functionalism. The diagram captures the section's argument about the difference between real and merely fashionable adoption of new methodology.
